decisions.reason: The car transporter line carries substantial sunk tooling and development investment and supports the announced push toward professional users and international markets, so management will attribute the lack of visibility on the website to temporary causes and persist.
The low-bed series was showcased on the home page as part of the core range, and the firm's public commitment and sunk costs make withdrawal unlikely despite reduced visibility.
The high-cover series builds on core trailer platforms and was publicly featured, so dropping it would undercut earlier decisions and waste shared investments.

Although B was already withdrawn, F remains the firm's box trailer offering and was prominently launched, so management will keep it, while its weaker standing leaves a somewhat higher risk of consolidation.
